supportedActions.notes: REG-138: directly executable -- SemanticBehaviorWriteBackService.applyMutationToModelSourceAt writes a real capabilityCall step targeting the model's own 'notification' capability into the app's own model source (npdev.model.sourcePath), applied on the next regenerate+rebuild.
No approval-capability convention exists in the DSL yet; a human must model this manually.
A bare retryCount does not identify which step's policy to adjust; requires manual targeting.
A bare timeoutSeconds does not identify which step's policy to adjust; requires manual targeting.

notes: REG-138 (2026-08-07): this file was a completely empty seeded placeholder (no supportedActions key at all) from the day this service shipped, which meant isDirectlyExecutable() could never return true for ANY app -- canonicalize() always fell through to the 'no matching rule' branch (outcome=UNSUPPORTED), regardless of what SemanticBehaviorWriteBackService itself checked for. Populated with the 4 action types SemanticBehaviorWriteBackCanonicalizationService/SemanticBehaviorWriteBackService already recognize by name; only addNotificationStep is currently backed by real execution logic.
